description: This file implements input handling classes for Firefox in the Playwright project, including keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen input methods, with specific handling for Firefox key codes and events.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input methods for Firefox, including keydown, keyup, and text input.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Implements mouse input methods for Firefox, including move, down, up, wheel, and setting the page context.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Implements touchscreen tap input for Firefox.

methods.name: toFirefoxKeyDescription
methods.description: Overrides certain key descriptions with Firefox-specific key codes for volume keys.

methods.name: toModifiersMask
methods.description: Converts a set of keyboard modifiers to a bitmask.

methods.name: toButtonNumber
methods.description: Converts mouse button string to a numeric code.

methods.name: toButtonsMask
methods.description: Converts a set of mouse buttons to a bitmask.
